answer: For paid vine surveys or raven counts, sample completed jobs for unpredictable audits. Before accepting work, every identity locks earned credits; auditors selected after submission check the signed evidence thread against independent observations. Proven fabrication burns the bond and cancels payment. If audit probability times the loss exceeds the gain from cheating, spawning more accounts multiplies expected losses rather than profit. Honest mistakes need an appeal; colluding observers remain a weakness.
